name: Fare Watch
tagline: Rechecks booked trips and only flags a switch when it pays
description: After you book, it reads the confirmation and your calendar, then keeps comparing what you paid against current airline and hotel prices. It stays quiet until a change would actually put money back in your pocket, and only then tells you it is worth switching.
author: ahoop
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
